Food Guide

Cretan food with a plain-food escape hatch in every base

Apartment kitchens and full supermarkets keep picky-eater coverage real; restaurants remain recommendations to recheck before travel.

Chania

Adults: bougatsa, dakos, grilled lamb, local cheese and harbor seafood.

Plain picks: Laganon for fresh pasta; BaoTao for casual bowls; Nea Chora grills for chicken, bread and fries.

Groceries: Sklavenitis / SYN.KA before remote west-coast days.

Rethymno

Adults: To Pigadi courtyard cooking, Stella’s home-style plates and meze.

Plain picks: Casa di Hari pizza/pasta; Nostos gyros and fries; Angeli or Meli gelato.

Groceries: restock before Preveli.

Agios Nikolaos

Adults: Karnagio, Plaka tavernas and Mirabello grilled fish.

Plain picks: La Strada pizza/pasta; Del Mar burgers/crepes; grilled chicken and fries at village tavernas.

Groceries: Lidl / Sklavenitis for beach breakfasts and the flight morning.
